description: Returns one person's business email, mobile number and LinkedIn profile, by a person id from get_loan_companies. Calling or texting the number is subject to the TCPA and Do Not Call rules, which the answer repeats. Each new person opened counts against the account's monthly allowance (the same person again that month is free), and the answer says how many are left. Business use only; not a consumer report; no extracting or resale. Without a key it returns a tool error that says so.

person.description: A person id from get_loan_companies (16 hex characters)

name: reveal_contact

outputSchema.description: Every field with its unit and codes, in full: https://cmbs.news/openapi.json (operation revealContact). Money in US dollars; a rate, occupancy or share is a fraction of 1 (0.0475 is 4.75%) unless it says percent; DSCR is a multiple; dates YYYY-MM-DD.

allowance.description: The account's allowance after this call.

left.description: Count still available this month (of minus used, never below 0).

month.description: The calendar month the count is for, YYYY-MM, in UTC. The allowance restarts on the first of each month.

of.description: Count of people the plan may open per month: 250 on Pro, 1,000 on Team, 0 on free.

used.description: Count of different people this account has opened this month.

argumentNote.description: Sent when an argument was renamed, read in another form or left out because it could not be used: says which and how.

callsLeft.description: Without a key: calls left today on the free allowance, this one counted. Not sent with a Pro or Team key.

keyNote.description: Sent when the key given was a placeholder (such as YOUR_KEY): the call was answered as a call without a key, and this says why.

match.description: How the profile was matched to the person and company; null if not stored.

company.description: How closely the profile's employer matches the printed company name. Values: 100 = the employer's name is a printed name, legal forms aside; 90 = the employer's name is the leading words (two or more) of the printed name.

employer.description: The employer's name on the person's profile.

employerDomain.description: The employer's web domain; null when unknown.

name.description: How the name was matched. Values: same first and last name = the profile's first and last name are the person's (middle names, initials and suffixes aside); listed by MoltSets at the company's domain = the person was found as a decision maker at the operating company's web domain.

via.description: Present only for people found through the company's operating business; always 'operating company'. Values: operating company = found at the printed company's operating business rather than by the person's own name.

businessEmail.description: The person's business email at their employer's own domain; null when none is on file.

companyId.description: Id of the company the person is tied to (companies[].id in the companies answer); null if not stored.

emailRiskGrade.description: The data provider's (MoltSets) risk grade for the email. Values: A = kept grade (best of the three by ordering; meaning not defined in code); B = kept grade (meaning not defined in code); C = kept grade (meaning not defined in code).

emailValidated.description: Date the provider last validated the email, YYYY-MM-DD. Present only when known.

id.description: The person id that was asked for (16 hexadecimal characters).

linkedIn.description: Link to the person's LinkedIn profile; null when none is on file.

name.description: The person's name; null if not stored.

phone.description: The person's mobile number in international form, e.g.

phoneRules.description: Fixed sentence on the caller's duties under the TCPA and Do Not Call rules.

phoneType.description: Always 'mobile'. Present only when phone is not null. Values: mobile = a mobile number.

phoneValidated.description: Date the provider last validated the number, normally YYYY-MM-DD. Present only when a phone is on file and the date is known.

removal.description: Link the person (or anyone) can use to ask for this contact to be removed for good.

reportWrongContact.description: Link to report this contact as wrong.

source.description: Where these contact details come from: a business data provider, not SEC filings.

note.description: How the details were found and matched to the person and company, and that they are shown as found.

read.description: When the details were read from the provider, YYYY-MM-DD.

use.description: Fixed sentence on permitted use (same as in the companies answer).

title: Open one business contact
